text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday. I ordered some Japanese 
sweets from Kyoto. Would you care to have 
some?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fueh!? ...A-All the way from Kyoto...? I'm 
happy, but... is it really okay for 
someone like Rice to have this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Of course. Please, do accept it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I may have debuted earlier than you... but 
as your Tracen Academy junior, I have the 
utmost respect for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A stayer of Yodo who clings on 
relentlessly to the very end. Her 
running... truly makes my heart tremble 
with power.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because it's you that I 
wish to give these Kyoto sweets. Rice Sa—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...No, out of respect, please allow me to 
address you this way."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hauu... Th-Thank you. But... I'd really 
prefer if calling me "Senpai" was just for 
today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: M-My face will... turn as red as an apple.
